halloween.description: Your goal: Get 🍬 on the gold framed field. How? Tap a field and it might transform, depending on what objects are around it. The hidden rules are different for each puzzle.

rules.title: How it works
rules.p1: Tap any field. What it turns into depends only on its neighbors: the up to 8 fields around it, diagonals included. Fields at the edge have fewer.
rules.p2: What counts is which neighbors the field has and how many of each. What the tapped field shows right now does not matter.
rules.p3: Sometimes a tap does nothing. Only taps that change a field count as moves.
rules.p4: Within a game the rules never change: the same neighbors always give the same result. Find out what they are!
